legend: Kolya Gerasimov loves kefir very much. He lives in year 1984 and knows all the details of buying this delicious drink. One day, as you probably know, he found himself in year 2084, and buying kefir there is much more complicated.

Kolya is hungry, so he went to the nearest milk shop. In 2084 you may buy kefir in a plastic liter bottle, that costs a rubles, or in glass liter bottle, that costs b rubles. Also, you may return empty glass bottle and get c (c < b) rubles back, but you cannot return plastic bottles.

Kolya has n rubles and he is really hungry, so he wants to drink as much kefir as possible. There were no plastic bottles in his 1984, so Kolya doesn't know how to act optimally and asks for your help.
input: First line of the input contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1018) — the number of rubles Kolya has at the beginning.

Then follow three lines containing integers a, b and c (1 ≤ a ≤ 1018, 1 ≤ c < b ≤ 1018) — the cost of one plastic liter bottle, the cost of one glass liter bottle and the money one can get back by returning an empty glass bottle, respectively.
output: Print the only integer — maximum number of liters of kefir, that Kolya can drink.
note: In the first sample, Kolya can buy one glass bottle, then return it and buy one more glass bottle. Thus he will drink 2 liters of kefir.

In the second sample, Kolya can buy two plastic bottle and get two liters of kefir, or he can buy one liter glass bottle, then return it and buy one plastic bottle. In both cases he will drink two liters of kefir.

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 10^18）——Kolya 一开始拥有的卢布数。
接下来三行分别包含整数 a、b 和 c（1 ≤ a ≤ 10^18，1 ≤ c < b ≤ 10^18）——它们分别表示一个塑料升装瓶的价格、一个玻璃升装瓶的价格，以及退回一个空玻璃瓶可以获得的钱数。

output.ai: 输出唯一的整数——Kolya 能喝的开菲尔的最大升数。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，Kolya 可以购买一个玻璃瓶，然后将其退回，再购买一个玻璃瓶。因此，他将喝到 2 升开菲尔。
在第二个样例中，Kolya 可以购买两个塑料瓶并得到 2 升开菲尔；或者，他可以购买一个一升装的玻璃瓶，然后将其退回并购买一个塑料瓶。在这两种情况下，他都将喝到 2 升开菲尔。

legend.ai: Kolya Gerasimov 非常喜欢开菲尔。他生活在 1984 年，了解购买这种美味饮料的所有细节。一天，正如你可能知道的那样，他来到了 2084 年，而在那里购买开菲尔要复杂得多。
Kolya 饿了，于是他去了最近的乳品店。在 2084 年，你可以买一升装的塑料瓶开菲尔，价格为 a 卢布；也可以买一升装的玻璃瓶开菲尔，价格为 b 卢布。此外，你可以退回空玻璃瓶并获得 c 卢布的退款（c < b），但不能退回塑料瓶。
Kolya 有 n 卢布，而且他非常饿，因此想尽可能多地喝开菲尔。1984 年没有塑料瓶，所以 Kolya 不知道如何做出最优选择，只好向你求助。
